content.title: Calm Foreground vs Background Disorder | Task Continuity
content.summary: A clearly adult lead keeps one restrained foreground action while non-graphic background disorder escalates and settles.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult original lead remains centered and identifiable. + A small foreground action stays continuous. + Background disorder escalates in readable stages. + Conflict remains non-graphic and safely choreographed. + The ending returns to the foreground task and pose.
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult archive supervisor holds one folder while a civic hall grows chaotic.
required_anchors: Establish one clearly adult original protagonist and one small repeatable foreground task before hazards escalate.
Escalate at least three hazards from background activity to near contact while keeping their direction legible.
Use the minimum avoidance needed until one near-contact peak causes the largest body displacement.
End with the adult resuming the task after danger passes, not celebrating or defeating the threat.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A clearly adult lead keeps one restrained foreground action while non-graphic background disorder escalates and settles.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 将明确成年原创人物和一个极小前景动作锁在中心，后景从纸张、家具移动到人群奔跑逐级升压；人物只作必要响应并回到原节奏。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult original lead remains centered and identifiable.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult original lead remains centered and identifiable."

invariants.rule: A small foreground action stays continuous.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "A small foreground action stays continuous."

invariants.rule: Background disorder escalates in readable stages.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Background disorder escalates in readable stages."

invariants.rule: Conflict remains non-graphic and safely choreographed.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Conflict remains non-graphic and safely choreographed."

invariants.rule: The ending returns to the foreground task and pose.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The ending returns to the foreground task and pose."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
